_comment: Maps an open service/port found by nmap to the next tool in the attack chain. Keyed by nmap service name; 'port' is the fallback match when the service name is blank/unknown. 'tool' = next-stage tool package under src/tools/; 'module' = that tool's protocol/module argument; 'why' = short human reason shown in the wizard.

ftp.why: FTP login — brute force with Hydra

ssh.why: SSH login — brute force with Hydra

telnet.why: Telnet login — brute force with Hydra

smtp.why: SMTP auth — brute force with Hydra

http.why: HTTP auth — brute force with Hydra

https.why: HTTPS auth — brute force with Hydra

microsoft-ds.why: SMB open — try Evil-WinRM once creds are found

ms-wbt-server.why: RDP login — brute force with Ncrack

mysql.why: MySQL login — brute force with Hydra

ms-sql-s.why: MSSQL login — brute force with Hydra

wsman.why: WinRM open — get a shell with Evil-WinRM

wsmans.why: WinRM (TLS) open — get a shell with Evil-WinRM
